facts.fact: The Wavemaker API is available on Pro and Business plans.
facts.quote: The API is available on Pro and Business plans.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's REST video endpoint is /api/v1/videos, where a POST request starts a trackable job.
Wavemaker's API has a rate limit of 30 requests per minute.
facts.quote: 30 requests per minute. Plenty for event-driven automation.

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker, generating most videos takes 2 to 5 minutes.
facts.quote: Generation takes 2 to 5 minutes for most videos

facts.fact: Each Wavemaker video generation request spends roughly 75 credits for a 30-second video.
facts.quote: Each request spends credits (roughly 75 for a 30-second video, 150 for 60 seconds).

facts.fact: The Wavemaker Pro plan includes 2,000 credits a month with 20% rollover.
facts.quote: Pro includes 2,000 credits a month with 20% rollover;

facts.fact: The Wavemaker Business plan includes 8,000 credits with 50% rollover and built-in webhooks.
facts.quote: Business includes 8,000 with 50% rollover and webhooks built in.

facts.fact: Wavemaker credit packs start at $9.99 per 100 credits and never expire.
facts.quote: top up with credit packs (from $9.99 per 100), which never expire.

facts.fact: The Wavemaker API rate limit is 30 requests per minute, according to the page.
facts.quote: 30 requests per minute is generous, but a batch job can blow through it.

facts.fact: Per the page, a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50.
facts.quote: A finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50

facts.fact: API access starts on the Wavemaker Pro plan at $99 per month.
facts.quote: API access starts on the Pro plan at $99/mo, which includes 2,000 credits a month

facts.fact: The Wavemaker Business plan costs $299 per month and adds native webhooks and up to 4K export.
facts.quote: Business at $299/mo adds webhooks natively, up to 4K export, and a much larger credit allowance.

facts.fact: The Wavemaker Free and Starter plans do not include API access.
facts.quote: The Free and Starter plans don't include API access.

facts.fact: According to the page, most Wavemaker videos finish generating in 2 to 5 minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos finish in 2 to 5 minutes.

facts.fact: New users can create their first Wavemaker video free with 75 credits.
facts.quote: Create your first video free with 75 credits
